correctness.rationale: For G_n=K_n square K_2 under synchronous 3-state threshold-one Greenberg--Hastings update, every matched pair has one of nine ordered types (a,b); its successor depends only on whether any left or right type contains state 1. Occupied-type support therefore determines all iterates for every n. The 511 nonempty supports are exhaustively checked with exact symbolic transition; F^16=F^4, least eventual periods 1,3,4, entry <=4, and the nine-row by-period support table. Inclusion-exclusion surjections U_j(n) produce B1=3*4^n+6*3^n-12*2^n+3, B3=9^n-9*4^n+18*2^n-9, B4=6*(4^n-3^n-2^n+1); four-step bound is sharp. Counting recurrent support classes and three-coloring criterion gives C4=2^n-2 (known) and stated C3. Independent nine-type support computation checked all 511 supports and direct vertexwise dynamics 7371 labelled states n=2,3,4; these corroborate a genuinely exhaustive finite 9-type reduction, not merely small-n extrapolation.
